title: Tech Note: Using External Databases for Speed, Simplicity and Security
author: Charles “Charlie” Vass, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note demonstrates 4D v12's CREATE DATABASE/USE DATABASE SQL commands for splitting data across external databases (archiving, sandboxing, per-test-runner databases), a classic-language SQL data-segregation technique that still functions in current 4D. The pattern is still valid as a fallback, though ORDA's ability to work with multiple datastores/entity selections and 4D's modern multi-base architecture give developers more structured, entity-oriented alternatives for many of the same data-segregation goals today.
related_updates: ORDA (4D v16 R5+, 2017) offers entity-based access across multiple datastores as a more structured alternative for some segregation scenarios
